preamble: Caravan Crossing (Complex): The five caravans rely entirely on human runners—desert couriers carrying parchment slips between groups. Many dangers disrupt this fragile communication system: a collapsed camel, a courier lost behind a dune, or a sandstorm that forces runners to turn back. In this scenario, SaffronHerald collapses early and cannot dispatch or receive runners. Soon after, a sandstorm reshapes the caravan's formation, pushing caravans into separate partitions that no messenger can traverse. AmberLead’s initial proposal cannot gather enough responses to form a quorum. Later, as the storm clears and SaffronHerald recovers, NavajoElder initiates a new proposal. With runner routes restored, consensus on the campsite can finally be reached.
